contexts: regional cancer centre, chemotherapy day unit
breast and colorectal clinics reporting since March 2026
lung and head-and-neck clinics from January 2027
reading: The benefit of weekly reporting depends on a loop: a patient reports, a nurse responds, the patient keeps reporting. The retrieved trials show the benefit when the loop is staffed; routine-care evidence shows the loop breaking at the response step, with completion falling after unanswered alerts, especially at weekends and among older and more deprived patients. The local question sits on that loop, not on whether the intervention can work.
